summary.text: Shea Backus is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Assembly representing District 37 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously served in the Assembly from 2018 to 2020 and returned in 2022; she is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Shea Backus was born in and lives in Las Vegas, Nevada, and graduated from Edward W. Clark High School in 1993.

She earned a B.S. in management science from the University of California, San Diego, in 1998 and a J.D. from Arizona State University's Sandra Day O'Connor College of Law in 2003, and her career experience includes working as an attorney.
She served in the Nevada State Assembly for District 37 from 2018 to 2020, when Andy Matthews succeeded her, and assumed office again on November 9, 2022.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Growth and Infrastructure, Revenue (as chair), and Ways and Means (as vice chair) committees.
Her Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Jill Douglass.
